questions.question: If 16 th May 2017 was Tuesday, what was the day of the week on 13 th May, 2015?
questions.questionHtml: If 16<sup>th</sup> May 2017 was Tuesday, what was the day of the week on 13<sup>th</sup> May, 2015?
questions.solution:
As given, 16th May 2017 = Tuesday So, in 2016 16th May = Monday as the number of. odd day = 1 and in 2015, 16th May = Monday - 2 = Saturday (as 2016 was a leap year).

Then 16th May to 13th May = 3 days. So, Saturday - 3 = Wednesday.

Hence, the correct answer is Wednesday.

questions.question: If ‘+’ indicates mathematical action ‘-‘ and ‘×’ indicates mathematical action ‘÷’ then what is the value of ((75 + 25) × 5) × 10?
questions.questionHtml: If ‘+’ indicates mathematical action ‘-‘ and ‘×’ indicates mathematical action ‘÷’ then what is the value of ((75 + 25) × 5) × 10?
questions.solution:
Symbol

+

×

Meaning

-

÷


Given: ((75 + 25) × 5) × 10

On decoding: ((75 - 25) ÷ 5) ÷ 10

→ ((75 - 25) ÷ 5) ÷ 10

→ ((50) ÷ 5) ÷ 10

→ (10) ÷ 10

→ 1

Hence, on decoding the value of ((75 + 25) × 5) × 10 is 1.

questions.question: Direction:- Statement is given followed by two inferences I and II. You have to consider the statement to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given inferences, if any, follow from the given statement? Statement : Gujarat has the highest employment rate in the country, while other states lack an employment exchange and related infrastructure. Inferences : I. Gujarat has a good employment exchange and also good infrastructure to provide opportunities for employment. II. Literacy rate of Gujarat, is the lowest in India.
questions.questionHtml:
Direction:- Statement is given followed by two inferences I and II. You have to consider the statement to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given inferences, if any, follow from the given statement?

Statement: Gujarat has the highest employment rate in the country, while other states lack an employment exchange and related infrastructure.

Inferences:

I. Gujarat has a good employment exchange and also good infrastructure to provide opportunities for employment.

II. Literacy rate of Gujarat, is the lowest in India.
questions.solution:
The reason for Gujarat having the highest employment rate in the country should be what the other states are lacking. Thus, inference I follows as it states the same.

There is no mention about the literacy rate of Gujarat in the statement and no mention of any relation between employment and literacy. Thus inference II does not follow.

questions.question: Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number. 64 : 18 :: 196 : 24 :: 529 : ?
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

64 : 18 :: 196 : 24 :: 529 : ?
questions.solution:
Logic : Square root of first number + 10 = second number

1) 64 : 18

⇒ √64 + 10 

⇒ 8 + 10 = 18

And,

2) 196 : 24 

⇒ √196 + 10 

⇒ 14 + 10 = 24

Similarly,

3) 529 : ?

⇒ √529 + 10

⇒ 23 + 10 = 33

Hence, the correct answer is "33".

questions.question: Directions: Answer the question given below You are sitting in a park and you see a mother telling her daughter to stay away from the kids of an under-privileged family, who are also playing in the same park. What will you do?
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Answer the question given below

You are sitting in a park and you see a mother telling her daughter to stay away from the kids of an under-privileged family, who are also playing in the same park. What will you do?

options.text: Tell the daughter to play with those kids despite what her mother might have told her.
options.html: Tell the daughter to play with those kids despite what her mother might have told her.

options.text: Talk to the mother and make her realize that teaching her daughter discrimination based on status is wrong.
options.html: Talk to the mother and make her realize that teaching her daughter discrimination based on status is wrong.

options.text: Ignore the situation, it is a personal matter of the mother and the daughter.
options.html: Ignore the situation, it is a personal matter of the mother and the daughter.

options.text: Encourage the kids of the under-privileged family to make friends with the daughter.
options.html: Encourage the kids of the under-privileged family to make friends with the daughter.

questions.solution:
In the given situation, the mother must realize that she is preaching a wrong concept to her daughter. Discrimination based on status is wrong and the mother must understand it so that she would not teach it to her daughter. As an aware and educated citizen, it is your duty to act against this kind of discrimination. Therefore options 1, 3, and 4 are incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: In a row of 18 girls, when Natasha was shifted by two places towards the left, she became 9 th from the left end. What was her earlier position from the right end of the row?
questions.questionHtml: In a row of 18 girls, when Natasha was shifted by two places towards the left, she became 9<sup>th</sup> from the left end. What was her earlier position from the right end of the row?
questions.solution:
As per the given information:

In a row of 18 girls, when Natasha was shifted by two places towards the left, she became 9th from the left end.

Thus, the old position of Natasha will be 11th from the left end.

Now,

Total girls= Natasha's earlier position from left + Natasha's earlier position from right -1 

⇒ Natasha's position from right = Total girls - Natasha's earlier position from left + 1

⇒ 18 - 11 + 1

⇒ 7 + 1

⇒ 8

Thus, Natasha's earlier position from the right end of the row is '8th'.

Hence, the correct answer is "8th".

questions.question: If + is interchanged with ×, and - is interchanged with ÷, then which value can replace the question mark (?) n the following equation? 18 + 9 ÷ 53 × 76 - 19 = ?
questions.questionHtml:
If + is interchanged with ×, and - is interchanged with ÷, then which value can replace the question mark (?) n the following equation?

18 + 9 ÷ 53 × 76 - 19 = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 18 + 9 ÷ 53 × 76 - 19 = ?

Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule as per the order given below:

According to the given information,

If '+' is interchanged with '×', and '-' is interchanged with '÷',  then the new equation thus formed is :

New Equation : 18 × 9 - 53 + 76 ÷ 19 = ?

Now, by following the BODMASS rule we have :

⇒ 18 × 9 - 53 + 76 ÷ 19 = ?

⇒ 18 × 9 - 53 + 4

⇒ 162 - 53 + 4

⇒ 166 - 53

⇒ 113

Hence, the correct answer is "113".

questions.question: Given below is a statement followed by two possible underlying assumptions I and II. Read the information carefully and select the correct option. Statement: Research has suggested that regular physical activity not only reduces the chances of physical illness but also of mental illnesses. Which of the following can be assumed by the given statement? I. The medicines for mental illness would work faster if the patient also exercises daily. II. Patients who are bedridden have a greater chance of developing some mental illness as compared to those who are not bedridden.
questions.questionHtml:
Given below is a statement followed by two possible underlying assumptions I and II. Read the information carefully and select the correct option.

Statement:

Research has suggested that regular physical activity not only reduces the chances of physical illness but also of mental illnesses.

Which of the following can be assumed by the given statement?

I. The medicines for mental illness would work faster if the patient also exercises daily.

II. Patients who are bedridden have a greater chance of developing some mental illness as compared to those who are not bedridden.

options.text: Both I and II can be assumed
options.html: Both I and II can be assumed

options.text: Neither I nor II can be assumed
options.html: Neither I nor II can be assumed

questions.solution:
I. Assumption I is not implicit as the statement does not mention anything about the impact of medicine on mental illness or the role of daily exercise.

II. Assumption II is implicit as it is based on the research suggesting the benefits of physical activity for mental and physical health, and it logically follows from the fact that bedridden patients are less likely to engage in physical activity, potentially leading to mental health issues.
